hyperedges.label: User persona stress tests (Casey, Riley, Jordan)

nodes.label: Persona: Riley (edge-case tester)
nodes.rationale: find(...)! crashes on missing id; no quantity max; 'R$ 1279,60' lacks thousands separator; logout clears cart; fixed heights clip large text.

nodes.label: [P1] Keyboard Covers Login Button & Search Issues
nodes.norm_label: [p1] keyboard covers login button & search issues
nodes.rationale: Keyboard hides 'Entrar' on Login; no results visible while typing; search not accent-insensitive.

nodes.label: App Logo (purple rounded square with white checkmark)
nodes.norm_label: app logo (purple rounded square with white checkmark)
nodes.rationale: Custom brand mark: violet/lavender rounded square with a white check mark, suggesting a task/to-do style app. Differs from the default Expo icons in assets/.

nodes.label: Splash Icon (gray grid with concentric circles)
nodes.norm_label: splash icon (gray grid with concentric circles)
nodes.rationale: Neutral gray grid with three concentric circles; default Expo template splash placeholder.

nodes.label: Automated Anti-pattern Detector
nodes.rationale: 0 findings likely unreliable: detector reads HTML/CSS but app is React Native; browser preview skipped (no react-native-web / react-dom).

nodes.label: [P0] Missing Checkout Flow
nodes.rationale: checkout() in Cart/index.tsx empties cart and jumps to confirmation with no address, payment or review.

nodes.label: Patinhas Petshop App
nodes.rationale: Screen structure reads as a generic store template; petshop identity lives only in copy and pastel species colors. Missing pet profile, scheduled food purchase, Pix, installments, CEP, grooming.

nodes.label: [P1] Small Touch Targets & Incomplete Screen Reader Support
nodes.norm_label: [p1] small touch targets & incomplete screen reader support
nodes.rationale: 28pt +/- cart buttons; missing field labels, card '+' label, decorative emojis, '1 itens'.

nodes.label: Typography & Spacing Inconsistency
nodes.rationale: Weight 800 nearly everywhere, ~14 font sizes without scale; 12pt vs 20pt margins; 40pt vs 48pt close button.

nodes.label: [P2] Unusable Coupon AUAU30 & Clarity Issues
nodes.rationale: Coupon and '10% off' cannot be applied; banner not tappable; logout hidden in avatar; section title ignores filter.

nodes.label: Nielsen Heuristics Score (20/40)
nodes.rationale: Lowest scores: error prevention (1) and help/documentation (1); one-tap order finalization and re-adding on 'Adicionado' tap.

nodes.label: Expo Default Template Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: Shared blue chevron mark across the placeholder icon set shipped by create-expo-app; the custom logo has not been propagated to these.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Background (Expo default blueprint grid)
nodes.norm_label: android adaptive icon background (expo default blueprint grid)
nodes.rationale: Light-blue construction-guide background layer (circles and dashed guide lines) from the default Expo template; placeholder not yet customized.

nodes.label: Android Adaptive Icon Foreground (Expo chevron)
nodes.rationale: Blue gradient caret/chevron (Expo 'A' mark) on transparent background; default Expo template placeholder.

nodes.label: Android Monochrome Icon (gray Expo chevron)
nodes.rationale: Gray single-color chevron used for Android 13+ themed icons; default Expo template placeholder.

nodes.label: Web Favicon (small Expo chevron)
nodes.rationale: Tiny blue chevron on light background for the web build; default Expo template placeholder.

nodes.label: App Icon (Expo chevron on blueprint)
nodes.rationale: 1024x1024 composite of the blue chevron over the light-blue construction grid; default Expo template app icon, not yet rebranded.
